controls.bridge: For each parent retain the two para-phenylene–anthracene–terminal-aryl arms and replace the central C(CF3)2 unit with C≡C. The explicit graphs define all atoms, stoichiometry and charge.

mapping.meaning: Full unchanged two-arm correspondence with identical elements and bond orders. Central C(CF3)2 and C≡C bridge atoms are unmatched intervention atoms.

controls.torsions: Enumerate all non-ring aromatic C-C single bonds on each matched arm (phenylene–anthracene and anthracene–terminal aryl). Orient each quadruple using lower mapped aromatic neighbor on each side; record integer quadruples. Fix corresponding absolute torsions at 60° with the same signed arm orientation, then compare with independent relaxed structures. No bridge bond is deleted to force a geometry.
controls.states: Primary comparison is S1 and T1 vertical at each corresponding S0 geometry; match NTO/transition-density character in a state window, not just root index. Also relax S1/T1 for each parent and π control to compare adiabatic gaps on the same S0 energy zero, listed separately. Triplet f is spin-forbidden/unsupported under ordinary spin-free TDDFT; do not fabricate oscillator strengths.
controls.energy_test: Mvertical=2 Evertical(T1)-Evertical(S1); Madiabatic uses separately defined relaxed electronic gaps. Never mix vertical and adiabatic gaps in one inequality.

source_notes: Main PDF pp2–4 structures, quantum method and singlet/triplet discussion; SI p2 source method.
molecular_boundary: The π controls are newly defined ethynyl-bridged counterfactuals, not source-synthesized materials. Replacing Ar-C(CF3)2-Ar by Ar-C≡C-Ar changes composition as well as conjugation; no total-energy reaction difference is meaningful without a balanced reference. Test molecular energy compatibility only, not TTA rate, efficiency or occurrence. All required comparisons are core; the optional extension listed below is not a completion condition. A documented failure is a valid submission but is not scientific completion. Evidence-supported collapse of an initialized basin, or inability to distinguish explanations after completing the core matrix, is scientifically admissible. An unattempted core comparison cannot be replaced by an uncertainty statement.
optional_not_required: Full concentration-dependent kinetics, films, TTA efficiency and nonadiabatic propagation are outside this version.
